title: Population Distribution
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use beans on a drawn county map: many beans near the river, the town and the road, few on the dry hills. The child moves the beans and says why.

skills.key_step: The child says where people are many and where few in a county, and gives the reason: water, fertile soil, work, roads, security.

floor.question: Which is bigger: a county of 3,000 or 900 square kilometres?

representations: beans on a drawn county map
a dot map of an imaginary county
photos of a busy town and empty dry land
steps: Look at where the dots or beans bunch up.
Give a reason for each from the land and services.
contexts: many homes near the tarmac road and the market
few homes on steep, dry hills
crowding near a factory that gives jobs

board.do: Draw a river with many dots along it and a hill with few dots.

board.say: Why might many people live here?

board.do: Wait for water or good soil.
Write "dense: water, good soil" by the river and "sparse: steep and dry" on the hill.

listen_for: The total number of people in a county
misconceptions.repair: Place twelve counters on a page: first all in one corner, then spread out; the total is the same.

misconceptions.ask: An area has many people living close together. Is it dense or sparse?
misconceptions.repair: Compare ten learners in a small room and ten on a football pitch.

listen_for: Because there is no water there
misconceptions.ask: Why do many people live near a river with good soil and rain?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what the family needs each day and where they find it.

misconceptions.ask: Is the number of people the same in every part of a county?
misconceptions.repair: Drop beans on the map where the class thinks people live; the beans bunch up.

checks.question: Many people live near a river with fertile soil. What is that area called: dense or sparse?
Give one reason few people live in a place.
checks.answer: any of: very dry, steep, floods, unsafe, no roads or work
